title: When he says 'it was nothing' after a PENTAKILL
caption:
He carried the whole game and still played it cool.
She cheers from the bed as his screen flashes PENTAKILL - he just smirks like it was nothing.
Having someone who celebrates your wins like their own hits different.
Would you hype him up mid-game or let him lock in?
Follow @fruit_drama_tv for more cozy little stories like this.
